## What's New

- Added scheduled reminders with named tasks.
- Supports one-time, daily, and weekday reminder schedules.
- Due reminders automatically expand the island for five seconds.
- Reminder tasks are stored locally in macOS preferences.

## Upgrade Notes

- This release bumps Lumina to version 0.2.0.
- Existing clipboard history, focus timer state, and media integrations are unchanged.
